text:
Priya: quick econ snapshot for saffron-11b int6 bring-up. TL;DR: cost ~0.9x of baseline, slight quality +0.6% MRR on dev slice, p95 latency +12ms. Details below.

Priya: baseline = nova7b-int8, saffron-11b-int6 run on a100-80gb, seq=512, batch=8.

Priya: metrics (dev-slice, 100k prompts):
```
model,slo_p50_ms,slo_p95_ms,token_cost_usd_per_million,MRR
nova7b-int8,28,90,85,0.742
saffron-11b-int6,34,102,76,0.747
```

Kai: what's the KV cache hit behaviour? batch config? :thinking_face:

Priya: KV cache warm; effective cache hit ~62% on convo workloads. batch config above; continuous batching enabled in runtime.

Evelyn (eval-bot): automated eval summary:
- QA F1: +0.4
- hallucination rate (strict): +0.2% absolute
- answer-length variance: small increase
full eval link: https://redwood.internal/evals/5467 (internal)

Sam: interesting. Unit econ: saffron token cost ~10.6% lower, but p95 latency +13% — ok for async jobs but risky for chat-heavy flows.

Jordan: Product Q: is +0.005 MRR material for GTN? how confident are we on slices like search-queries?

Priya: MRR uplift concentrated in instruction-following slices and multi-turn followups. On short search queries we see neutral. Confidence: bootstrap CI ~0.3%.

Sam: routing recs:
- default: `model:saffron-11b-int6` for non-critical routes (>=100ms p95 SLO)
- canary: 10% of chat-internal traffic for 48h
- fallback: `nova7b-int8` on p95 exceed or on hallucination alert
- quant flag: `enable_int6_kv_prefetch=true`

Priya: deployment checklist:
1) run 1k-convo soak in canary
2) enable per-route scorecard monitoring (MRR/latency/hallucination)
3) rollback triggers: delta_MRR <= -0.5% OR hallucination +0.6% OR p95 +30ms

Kai: infra notes: est capacity per A100-80=1200 tok/s baseline; saffron increases mem bandwidth but overall throughput ~0.95x. Recommend reserve +15% headroom for canary.

Jordan: ok — product ok to greenlight canary if Sam + Ops sign off. @Sam @Kai can you do final check today?

Sam: on it, starting canary infra prep now. ETA 3h.

deploy-bot: canary deployment scheduled: saffron-11b-int6 -> cluster-ml-canary at 2026-05-17T15:42Z

Priya: thanks team. will post follow-up with 24h canary metrics.
